## Core Value Proposition & Manufacturing Standards
- Zero Adulteration: 100% Atta, 0% Maida in whole wheat packages.
- Zero Synthetic Additives: No artificial bleaching agents (benzoyl peroxide free, potassium bromate free).
- Precision Milling: Temperature-controlled cold stone chakki milling preserving live wheat bran and natural germ.
- Soft Roti Guarantee: High water absorption capacity producing soft, puffed rotis that stay tender for hours.
- Dual Capability: Retail consumer packs (1kg, 5kg, 10kg) and industrial B2B bulk supply (25kg, 50kg bags).

### 3. Sri Gold Bombay Rava (Soji / Semolina)
- Application: Authentic Upma, Rava Idli, Kesari Bath, Rava Dosa.

### 4. Sri Gold Bansi Rava (Cracked Wheat Rava)
- Application: High-fiber diabetic-friendly Upma, Pongal, nutritious porridge.
- Glycemic Index: Low glycemic profile with intact germ.

### 5. Sri Gold Pure Roasted Besan (Gram Flour)
- Application: Laddu, Mysore Pak, Mirchi Bajji, Pakoda, savory snacks.
- Source: 100% pure Chana Dal, slow roasted for rich golden aroma.

### 6. Sri Gold Commercial Chakki Fresh Atta (50kg Bags)
- Target Market: Hostels, hotels, restaurants, industrial canteens, catering companies.
